sentences.text: Veillonella atypica is a lactate-utilizing bacterium detected in human faecal samples.
In a metagenomic study of hepatitis E, Veillonella atypica emerged as the most robust candidate biomarker among species associated with disease severity.
A review states that gut bacterial species such as Veillonella atypica improve muscle endurance and strength when administered as probiotics in animal models.

A review describes reports that Porphyromonas gingivalis and Veillonella atypica translocate from the mouth to pancreatic tumours, promoting carcinogenesis by inducing a pro-inflammatory tumour microenvironment.
